reason: I buy one big cheap bag of dry food with the groceries and my cat only gets wet food once in a while, so I have no real reason to add a new brand. Your dry food at RM 19.90 a kilo is also well above what I pay per kilo for the big bag.
objection: It only says 'no pork ingredients'. That is not the same as halal-certified, and I don't see a halal logo, so I'm not comfortable bringing it into my kitchen.
would_change_my_mind: A proper recognised halal logo on the pack, plus a big bag of dry food (7kg or more) priced to match the cheap bag I buy now, sold in a shop I already go to instead of by Facebook message.
